self_assessment: Added src/hooks/useWindowWidth.ts exporting the named hook useWindowWidth(): number. It seeds useState from UIStore.instance.windowWidth so the first render returns the current value, subscribes to UI_EVENTS.Resize in a useEffect with an empty dependency list and re-reads UIStore.instance.windowWidth on each event, and returns a cleanup that calls UIStore.instance.off(UI_EVENTS.Resize, handler) so the listener is dropped on unmount - matching how EffectsOverlay already listens to the store. Verified by transpiling the real file with tsc and rendering it through @testing-library/react under jsdom against a stub UIStore: the initial render reports the store's width, exactly one Resize listener is registered, emitting Resize after changing windowWidth re-renders with the new value, a further emit keeps that value, and the listener count returns to zero after unmount. Standalone tsc over the file reports only the same unresolved-module errors the existing UIStore consumers produce in this environment (react and the events-backed on/off), so nothing new; the repo's jest suite is unrunnable here because matrix-js-sdk is a github: dependency and the proxy blocks codeload.github.com.
